نتناسى (form VI)
# نَتَنَاسَى (natanāsā) /na.ta.naː.saː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَنَاسَى (tanāsā)
# نُتَنَاسَى (nutanāsā) /nu.ta.naː.saː/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَنَاسَى (tanāsā)
